SURGERY BOARD VIDEO BANK — OFFLINE DOWNLOAD KIT
1,028 narrated teaching videos, about 6 GB in total.

WHAT'S IN HERE
  download-all.command  Mac: double-click to download everything
  download-all.bat      Windows: double-click to download everything
  video-urls.txt        Plain list of all 1,028 links
  playlists/            One .m3u playlist per course, for VLC

Videos are sorted into a folder per course and named by question number,
e.g. Surgery-6th-Month-2013/surgery-6mo2013-01-ar.mp4

--------------------------------------------------------------------
MAC
  1. Put this folder where you want the videos (an external drive is fine).
  2. Double-click download-all.command
     If macOS blocks it: right-click > Open > Open.
  3. Leave it running. It prints progress like [412/1028].

WINDOWS
  1. Put this folder where you want the videos.
  2. Double-click download-all.bat

You can stop it at any time and run it again later. Finished videos are
skipped and interrupted ones resume, so nothing is downloaded twice.

--------------------------------------------------------------------
GETTING THEM ONTO AN iPHONE

Easiest — watch without filling up your phone:
  Install VLC (free, App Store). Open a playlist from playlists/ and stream
  any video. VLC can also save individual videos for offline use.

To put videos in the Photos app:
  1. Download on a Mac or PC using the scripts above.
  2. Mac: AirDrop a course folder to your iPhone, then Save to Photos.
     Windows: connect by cable and sync with iTunes / Apple Devices.

Download straight on the iPhone (no computer):
  Install "Documents by Readdle" (free). Open video-urls.txt inside it and
  download links directly. Fine for a few dozen videos; all 1,028 is a lot
  for a phone to handle in one go.

A NOTE ON SPACE
  All 1,028 videos are about 6 GB. If your iPhone is short on space, copy
  one course at a time, or stream with VLC instead of storing them.
